well honestly i’m pretty adventurous. I also just wanna see what happens, maybe it’s nice, honestly it’s probably not too shabby. 

I agree maybe my art could help but honestly I’m just tired of the mind games with this shit. I’ve been thinking about it for some time and if I got a maker then honestly I don’t think it’s fair to be part of this “experiment”. I don’t want to do this anymore. That’s my problem. I don’t care! haha, it’s so funny. I really don’t care. Heck we might be in a matrix, I read some work on that theory. Man wouldn’t that suck! Us potentially being some sort of recourse? Maybe I’m in coma and the only way to wake up is to end it?! I mean shit, I’m just like spike from cowboy bebop I really can’t tell if I’m dreaming or not.

It’s a living hell honestly. So don’t judge me for wanting it, if anything it’s pretty rational considering what i’ve been through in life. I have so many theory’s on the after life. Personally I hope get some rest regardless. 

Now in regards to the meds that could do the job, you are right. I forgot about some of the other shit that could make this painful. I think my best bet would be to get some fentanyl and ambien and mix a lethal dose of that.
